authorization.verbatim: Record founder decision: Courtyard by Marriott Detroit Novi and Sonesta Select Detroit Novi are the SAME BUILDING / successor identity at 42700 W 11 Mile Rd, 48375. Preserve the current canonical successor identity: Sonesta Select Detroit Novi. Retire/supersede the stale Courtyard identity through the sanctioned identity mechanism. Do not delete history.
authorization.note: This ruling is recorded on the operator's written instruction in the work order above. It is not a per-row founder note written at a review desk, and it is labelled that way on purpose.

evidence: Both identities are committed in the SAME census with the same street number, the same street and the same ZIP: '42700 W 11 Mile Rd' and '42700 West 11 Mile Rd', both 48375. The two spellings normalise to one address_key, which is the function the exclusion authority and the publication guard already use to decide whether two rows are one building.
The repaired shadow recensus absorbed them into ONE row independently, on street identity, from a local OpenStreetMap extract that had never seen either census.
The Courtyard row is IDENTITY_PROVISIONAL, carries NO official_url and has NO route in the authority shard. The Sonesta row is IDENTITY_CONFIRMED and carries a live first-party property page.
Only ONE hotel operates at that address. Two operating hotels would each hold their own brand property page; the Courtyard has none.

successor_identity.disposition: REMAINS CANONICAL -- unchanged by this ruling

history_preservation: Nothing is deleted. The Courtyard identity_key, its canonical name and its census row remain on the record; the ruling SUPERSEDES it rather than removing it.

On application, 'Courtyard by Marriott Detroit Novi' becomes the former_name of the Sonesta Select row -- the same mechanism this market already used for Delta Hotels DTW -> Skyline Hotel and for Best Western Premier Southfield -> Radisson Southfield.
The duplicate ledger keeps the full reasoning, as it does for the founder-confirmed Homewood Suites Novi duplicate.

why_not_applied_here.reason: Applying this ruling retires a row from the committed identity census, taking it from 182 to 181. This work order's standing prohibition is: do NOT overwrite the committed census until the shadow result is fully validated. The shadow result is NOT fully validated -- the reconciliation records four open promotion blockers, including a street-identity collapse that wrongly merges the EVEN / Hotel Indigo dual-brand pair. So the ruling is RECORDED here in full and its application is staged, rather than the census being edited while that prohibition is live.
what_is_needed_to_apply: Clear the promotion blockers listed in detroit_ann_arbor_shadow_reconciliation_003.json.

Then apply exactly the three edits in 'application_plan' below, in one pass, and re-pin the census count constants in tests/pettripfinder/contracts/test_market_authorities.py and test_market_geography.py from 182 to 181.

application_plan.action: Remove the 'courtyard by marriott detroit novi' row; census 182 -> 181.
Set former_name = 'Courtyard by Marriott Detroit Novi' on the 'sonesta select detroit novi' row.
Append a 'duplicate' item for 'courtyard by marriott detroit novi', duplicate_of 'sonesta select detroit novi', carrying this ruling_id and its evidence.

what_this_ruling_does_not_do: It does not promote the shadow census.
It does not change the Sonesta Select row's identity, route, policy state or evidence.
It does not rule on the other two street-identity collapses (575 W Big Beaver and 3764 S State St); both remain open and are recorded in the reconciliation.
